instruction: Please implement a recruitment website for hiring drivers and posting job listings. The website should have functionalities for user registration, job posting, job application, and contact form. Users should be able to register and create profiles, apply for jobs, and manage their contact information. Clients should be able to view their active job postings. The website should include pages such as home, about us, clients, drivers, jobs, and contact. Design the site using white as the background and navy for content blocks.

ui_instruct.task: Test user registration form submission.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A new user profile is created successfully, and a confirmation message is displayed indicating registration completion.

ui_instruct.task: Test job posting functionality for clients.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A new job listing is created and appears in the list of active job postings with correct details.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that users can apply for a job listing.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user's application is submitted successfully, and confirmation is displayed to the user.

ui_instruct.task: Check that users can update their contact information.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Changes to the contact information are saved, and a confirmation message is displayed to the user.

ui_instruct.task: Validate that the contact form can be submitted.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The contact form submission succeeds, and a thank you message is displayed to the user.

ui_instruct.task: Confirm navigation from the home page to the 'About Us' page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Clicking the 'About Us' link takes the user to the 'About Us' page without any errors.

ui_instruct.task: Verify accessibility of the home page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The home page is accessible.

ui_instruct.task: Check the ability for clients to view all their active job postings.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The client can see a list of all active job postings with correct and up-to-date information.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'navy', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement a blue-collar job site that connects blue-collar workers with employers. The website should allow users to create profiles, including name, contact information, skills and qualifications, email address, and photos. Users can browse and search job listings, including construction workers, plumbers, electricians, and more. Apply ivory for the layout background and forest green for interactive elements.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that a user can update their profile information (e.g., skills, contact details).
ui_instruct.expected_result: Updates are saved correctly and reflected in the user's profile without errors.

ui_instruct.task: Check the job search functionality by searching for "electrician" positions.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Search results display relevant job listings for electrician positions only, including the job title, employer, and location.

ui_instruct.task: Confirm that employers can post a new job listing with all required information (job description, requirements, contact details).
ui_instruct.expected_result: Job listing is successfully created and appears in the job listings with all entered details correctly displayed.

ui_instruct.task: Ensure the navigation links (home, profiles, job postings) are working correctly.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Clicking on each navigation link redirects the user to the appropriate page without errors.

ui_instruct.task: Test that users can view detailed job descriptions by clicking on a job listing.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Detailed job information is displayed, including job description, requirements, and employer contact details.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'ivory' as the background color and 'forest green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'ivory' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'forest green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement an internship portal website that connects students with companies offering internship opportunities. The website should have a student panel and a company panel, where students can browse and apply for internships, and companies can post internship positions. The website should also be optimized for speed, navigation, user interface, and user experience. Choose mint cream for the background; set all component colors to teal.

ui_instruct.task: Test the internship browsing functionality on the student panel.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Students can view a list of available internships, with each listing displaying consistent and correct company information, position description, and application deadline.

ui_instruct.task: Test the internship application submission functionality from the student panel.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Students can successfully apply for a chosen internship, receive a confirmation notification on the website, and an email acknowledgment of their application.

ui_instruct.task: Test the internship posting functionality on the company panel.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Companies can successfully post a new internship opportunity, which becomes immediately visible and accurately listed on the student browsing page.

ui_instruct.task: Test the cross-linking navigation between the student and company panels.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users can switch between the student and company panels with intuitive navigation elements and without encountering any broken links or navigation errors.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'mint cream' as the background color and 'teal' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'mint cream' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'teal', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement a high-performance sports recruitment platform that connects athletes and sports organizations. The platform should have functionalities for athlete registration, job posting, job application, and message notification. Users should be able to log in, browse job listings, apply for jobs of interest, and receive relevant notifications. Sports organizations should be able to post jobs, and communicate with athletes. Set ghost white as the body background and use slate gray for the UI.

ui_instruct.task: Attempt to register as an athlete on the platform using the provided registration form.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system successfully creates a new athlete account and displays a confirmation message.

ui_instruct.task: Log in as a sports organization using valid credentials.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system grants access to the organization dashboard without any errors.

ui_instruct.task: Post a new job listing as a sports organization.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The job listing appears in the job listings page, accurately reflecting the details entered.

ui_instruct.task: Apply for a job listing as an athlete.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A confirmation message appears confirming the application submission, and the application is logged in the athlete's account history.

ui_instruct.task: Send a message from a sports organization to a registered athlete through the platform's communication feature.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The athlete receives the message promptly, and a notification is displayed indicating a new message was received.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'ghost white' as the background color and 'slate gray' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'ghost white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'slate gray', accurately reflecting the design instruction.
